<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="tr">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>TÜRKLER BÖYLE Mİ? — Destek / Support / Поддержка</title>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Cormorant+Garamond:ital,wght@0,500;0,600;0,700;1,600&family=Nunito:wght@400;600;700;800&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
:root {
  --cream:#FBF5EA; --cream2:#F0E5CC; --clay:#C8412E; --clay-dark:#A53325;
  --teal:#1A6B5E; --teal-light:#228070; --gold:#C98A1A;
  --blue:#1A5C8B; --blue-light:#226BA3;
  --text:#2D1F12; --text-mid:#7A5C45; --text-soft:#B89A80; --white:#fff;
  --shadow: 0 2px 0 rgba(45,31,18,.08), 0 4px 16px rgba(45,31,18,.07);
  --shadow-h: 0 6px 0 rgba(45,31,18,.08), 0 12px 32px rgba(45,31,18,.12);
}
*,*::before,*::after{margin:0;padding:0;box-sizing:border-box;}
body{background:var(--cream);color:var(--text);font-family:'Nunito',sans-serif;min-height:100vh;overflow-x:hidden;}
body::before{content:'';position:fixed;inset:0;pointer-events:none;z-index:0;
  background:radial-gradient(ellipse 60% 40% at 10% 90%,rgba(200,65,46,.07) 0%,transparent 60%),
             radial-gradient(ellipse 50% 50% at 90% 10%,rgba(26,107,94,.07) 0%,transparent 60%),
             radial-gradient(ellipse 40% 60% at 70% 80%,rgba(201,138,26,.05) 0%,transparent 60%);}
.wrap{max-width:640px;margin:0 auto;padding:24px 20px 80px;position:relative;z-index:1;}

/* LANG */
.lang-bar{display:flex;justify-content:flex-end;gap:6px;margin-bottom:36px;}
.lb{background:transparent;border:1.5px solid var(--cream2);color:var(--text-mid);padding:5px 13px;border-radius:100px;font-family:'Nunito',sans-serif;font-size:13px;font-weight:800;cursor:pointer;transition:all .2s;}
.lb:hover{border-color:var(--clay);color:var(--clay);}
.lb.on{background:var(--clay);border-color:var(--clay);color:#fff;}

/* HEADER */
.hd{text-align:center;margin-bottom:32px;}
.avatar-ring{width:96px;height:96px;border-radius:50%;border:3px solid var(--clay);padding:3px;margin:0 auto 16px;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:0 4px 20px rgba(200,65,46,.25);}
.avatar-ring img{width:100%;height:100%;border-radius:50%;object-fit:cover;object-position:center 20%;}
.ch-name{font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;font-size:clamp(28px,6.5vw,42px);font-weight:700;color:var(--clay);letter-spacing:-.5px;margin-bottom:14px;}

.compliance-box{border:1.5px solid var(--cream2);background:rgba(45,31,18,.05);border-radius:12px;padding:10px 18px;margin:0 auto 18px;max-width:500px;}
.compliance-box p{font-size:12.5px;font-weight:700;color:var(--text-mid);line-height:1.6;text-align:center;}

.hd-title{font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;font-size:clamp(20px,4.5vw,26px);font-weight:600;color:var(--text);line-height:1.3;margin-bottom:8px;}
.hd-sub{font-size:14px;color:var(--text-mid);line-height:1.65;max-width:460px;margin:0 auto 20px;}

/* YT BUTTON */
.yt-btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:9px;padding:11px 26px;border-radius:13px;background:#FF0000;color:#fff;font-family:'Nunito',sans-serif;font-size:14.5px;font-weight:800;text-decoration:none;transition:all .2s;}
.yt-btn:hover{background:#CC0000;transform:translateY(-1px);box-shadow:0 4px 16px rgba(255,0,0,.3);}
.yt-btn svg{width:20px;height:20px;flex-shrink:0;}

/* CARD */
.card{background:var(--white);border-radius:20px;padding:22px 22px 20px;margin-bottom:14px;box-shadow:var(--shadow);border:1.5px solid rgba(45,31,18,.06);transition:transform .22s,box-shadow .22s;position:relative;overflow:hidden;}
.card:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);box-shadow:var(--shadow-h);}
.card.feat{border:2px solid var(--clay);}
.card.feat::after{content:'';position:absolute;top:0;left:0;right:0;height:3px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--clay),var(--gold));}
.c-top{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;margin-bottom:10px;}
.c-tag{display:inline-block;font-size:10.5px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.8px;text-transform:uppercase;padding:3px 10px;border-radius:100px;margin-bottom:7px;}
.t-red{background:rgba(200,65,46,.1);color:var(--clay);}
.t-blue{background:rgba(26,92,139,.1);color:var(--blue);}
.t-gold{background:rgba(201,138,26,.12);color:var(--gold);}
.t-teal{background:rgba(26,107,94,.1);color:var(--teal);}
.c-title{font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;font-size:22px;font-weight:700;color:var(--text);line-height:1.15;}
.c-icon{font-size:34px;flex-shrink:0;line-height:1;}
.c-desc{font-size:13.5px;color:var(--text-mid);line-height:1.65;margin-bottom:17px;}

/* BUTTONS */
.btn{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:7px;padding:11px 20px;border-radius:13px;font-family:'Nunito',sans-serif;font-size:14.5px;font-weight:800;text-decoration:none;transition:all .2s;cursor:pointer;border:none;width:100%;}
.btn-red{background:var(--clay);color:#fff;}
.btn-red:hover{background:var(--clay-dark);transform:translateY(-1px);}
.btn-blue{background:var(--blue);color:#fff;}
.btn-blue:hover{background:var(--blue-light);transform:translateY(-1px);}

/* IBAN */
.iban-panel{display:none;margin-top:16px;border-top:1px solid var(--cream2);padding-top:16px;}
.iban-panel.open{display:block;}
.iban-row{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;margin-bottom:10px;}
.iban-lbl{font-size:12px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.5px;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--text-soft);white-space:nowrap;}
.iban-val{font-family:'Courier New',monospace;font-size:12.5px;color:var(--text);font-weight:700;text-align:right;word-break:break-all;}
.iban-val.nm{font-family:'Nunito',sans-serif;font-size:13px;}
.iban-note{font-size:12px;color:var(--text-soft);margin-top:10px;line-height:1.5;}

/* CRYPTO */
.addr-box{background:var(--cream);border:1.5px solid var(--cream2);border-radius:12px;padding:12px 14px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;margin-bottom:8px;}
.addr-text{flex:1;font-family:'Courier New',monospace;font-size:11.5px;color:var(--text);word-break:break-all;line-height:1.5;user-select:all;}
.cp-btn{background:var(--white);border:1.5px solid var(--cream2);border-radius:8px;padding:5px 11px;font-size:12px;font-weight:800;color:var(--text-mid);cursor:pointer;flex-shrink:0;white-space:nowrap;transition:all .18s;font-family:'Nunito',sans-serif;}
.cp-btn:hover{border-color:var(--gold);color:var(--gold);}
.cp-btn.ok{border-color:var(--teal);color:var(--teal);}
.warn{font-size:12px;color:var(--clay);font-weight:700;margin-top:4px;}

/* QR */
.qr-block{margin-top:14px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:16px;padding:14px 16px;background:var(--cream);border:1.5px solid var(--cream2);border-radius:14px;}
.qr-img{width:88px;height:88px;flex-shrink:0;border-radius:8px;}
.qr-lbl{font-size:11px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.8px;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--text-soft);margin-bottom:5px;}
.qr-hint{font-size:12.5px;color:var(--text-mid);line-height:1.55;}

/* DIVIDER */
.div-row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;margin:28px 0 20px;}
.div-line{flex:1;height:1px;background:var(--cream2);}
.div-lbl{font-size:10.5px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:2px;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--text-soft);white-space:nowrap;}

/* FOOTER */
.ft{text-align:center;margin-top:52px;padding-top:28px;border-top:1px solid var(--cream2);}
.ft-q{font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;font-size:17px;font-style:italic;color:var(--text-mid);line-height:1.5;margin-bottom:10px;}
.ft-l{font-size:13px;color:var(--text-soft);}
.ft-l a{color:var(--clay);text-decoration:none;font-weight:800;}

@keyframes rise{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(16px)}to{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0)}}
.hd{animation:rise .5s ease both;}
.card{animation:rise .5s ease both;}
.card:nth-child(1){animation-delay:.05s} .card:nth-child(2){animation-delay:.12s}
.card:nth-child(3){animation-delay:.19s} .card:nth-child(4){animation-delay:.26s}

@media(max-width:480px){
  .wrap{padding:16px 15px 60px;} .card{padding:18px 16px 17px;} .ch-name{font-size:26px;}
  .iban-row{flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-start;gap:4px;} .iban-val{text-align:left;}
  .qr-block{flex-direction:column;} .qr-img{width:120px;height:120px;}
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<div class="wrap">

    "footer": '"Каждый комментарий, каждая поддержка — очень важны." — Елена 🧿',
    "iban-hide": "Скрыть",
    "bg-link": "https://donate.bynogame.com/en/turklerboylemi"
  }
};

const IDS = {
  compliance:"txt-compliance", title:"txt-title", sub:"txt-sub",
  "yt-btn":"txt-yt-btn", "tag-bg":"txt-tag-bg", "bg-desc":"txt-bg-desc", "bg-btn":"txt-bg-btn",
  "tag-iban":"txt-tag-iban", "iban-desc":"txt-iban-desc", "iban-btn":"txt-iban-btn",
  "iban-lbl-bank":"txt-iban-lbl-bank", "iban-lbl-name":"txt-iban-lbl-name", "iban-note":"txt-iban-note",
  "crypto-sep":"txt-crypto-sep",
  "usdt-desc":"txt-usdt-desc", "usdt-warn":"txt-usdt-warn", "usdt-qr":"txt-usdt-qr",
  "btc-desc":"txt-btc-desc", "btc-qr":"txt-btc-qr",
  "qr-lbl":"txt-qr-lbl", "btc-qr-lbl":"txt-btc-qr-lbl",
  footer:"txt-footer"
};

let cur = 'tr';
let ibanOpen = false;

function setLang(l) {
  cur = l;
  document.documentElement.lang = l;
  document.querySelectorAll('.lb').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('on'));
  document.getElementById('lb-' + l).classList.add('on');
  const T = TEXTS[l];
  for (const [key, elId] of Object.entries(IDS)) {
    const el = document.getElementById(elId);
    if (el && T[key]) el.textContent = T[key];
  }
  document.getElementById('bg-link').href = T["bg-link"];
  document.getElementById('cp-usdt').textContent = T["cp"];
  document.getElementById('cp-btc').textContent  = T["cp"];
  if (!ibanOpen) document.getElementById('txt-iban-btn').textContent = "🏦 " + T["iban-btn"];
}

function toggleIban() {
  ibanOpen = !ibanOpen;
  document.getElementById('iban-panel').classList.toggle('open', ibanOpen);
  const T = TEXTS[cur];
  document.getElementById('txt-iban-btn').textContent = ibanOpen
    ? "🔒 " + T["iban-hide"]
    : "🏦 " + T["iban-btn"];
}

function copy(btnId, addr) {
  const btn = document.getElementById(btnId);
  const ok  = TEXTS[cur]["cp-ok"];
  const reset = TEXTS[cur]["cp"];
  navigator.clipboard.writeText(addr).then(() => {
    btn.textContent = ok; btn.classList.add('ok');
    setTimeout(() => { btn.textContent = reset; btn.classList.remove('ok'); }, 2200);
  }).catch(() => {
    const ta = document.createElement('textarea');
    ta.value = addr; ta.style.cssText = 'position:fixed;opacity:0';
    document.body.appendChild(ta); ta.select(); document.execCommand('copy'); document.body.removeChild(ta);
    btn.textContent = ok; btn.classList.add('ok');
    setTimeout(() => { btn.textContent = reset; btn.classList.remove('ok'); }, 2200);
  });
}
</script>
</body>
</html>
